title.en: What Kind of Casual Dinner Host Are You?
title.zh: 轻松请吃饭：你会怎样安排这一桌？

description.en: Six imagined dinner choices about a flowing meal, flexible combinations and keeping preparation small enough to enjoy your own invitation.
description.zh: 六次想象晚餐选择，安排用餐节奏、灵活组合，也让准备规模小到自己能享受这份邀请。

introduction.en: Picture a casual fictional dinner with people you know. The quiz looks at the shape of the meal and the host’s workload; it is not a cooking, nutrition or dietary-suitability test. Different arrangements can all make a pleasant evening.
introduction.zh: 想象与熟人共享一顿轻松虚构晚餐。题目只看用餐形状与主人工作量，不测厨艺、营养或饮食适合程度。不同安排都可以让夜晚愉快。

focus.en: Hosting through a clear sequence, a table of choices or a deliberately simple preparation plan.
focus.zh: 通过清楚顺序、一桌可选组合或主动简化的准备计划来请客。

prompt.en: You begin planning the imaginary meal. You first decide…
prompt.zh: 开始计划想象晚餐，你先决定……

label.en: A simple order in which the parts of the meal will arrive.
label.zh: 各部分怎样按简单顺序上桌。

label.en: A few components people can combine in different ways.
label.zh: 几样可让人自行搭配的部分。

label.en: The smallest preparation plan that still sounds enjoyable.
label.zh: 仍让人期待的最小准备计划。

prompt.en: Several guests have different tastes. You prefer…
prompt.zh: 几位来客口味不同，你更愿……

label.en: A small range of clearly presented options.
label.zh: 几种清楚呈现的可选项。

label.en: One manageable shared meal agreed in advance.
label.zh: 提前约好一顿容易准备的共同餐。

label.en: A sequence with a moment to choose between two parts.
label.zh: 在顺序里留一次两者可选的时刻。

prompt.en: Preparation is taking longer than expected. You…
prompt.zh: 准备比预想花时间，你会……

label.en: Remove an extra dish so you can sit with the guests.
label.zh: 去掉额外一道，让自己也能坐下来。

label.en: Reshape the order so the ready part can begin the evening.
label.zh: 调整顺序，让已备好部分先开启夜晚。

label.en: Use a simpler set of components that still gives some choice.
label.zh: 改成更简单但仍可搭配的几个部分。

prompt.en: The first guests arrive early. You…

label.en: Give them a clear sense of how the meal will unfold.
label.zh: 简单说明这顿饭接着怎么展开。

label.en: Keep the welcome easy without adding another preparation task.
label.zh: 轻松欢迎，不再增加准备任务。

label.en: Show what is available now and what will be offered later.
label.zh: 说明现在与稍后分别有哪些可选。

prompt.en: Conversation is enjoyable as the meal ends. You choose…
prompt.zh: 饭接近结束，大家聊得开心，你选……

label.en: A relaxed closing with no extra course to produce.
label.zh: 放松收尾，不再做额外一道。

label.en: A small final shared moment that gives the meal a finish.
label.zh: 留一个小共同瞬间，让晚餐收束。

label.en: Letting people choose whether to linger or finish.
label.zh: 让大家自己选再待会儿或结束。

prompt.en: What would you like to repeat next time?

label.en: An arrangement that let different preferences coexist.
label.zh: 让不同偏好能并存的安排。

label.en: A meal with an easy beginning, middle and finish.
label.zh: 开始、中段、结尾都顺畅的一餐。

label.en: A scale of preparation that left me time to enjoy the company.
label.zh: 准备规模让我也有时间享受作伴。

summary.en: Your fictional dinner has a clear unfolding shape. The ready part begins, the next part has its moment and the meal can finish without confusion. The portrait values a useful sequence rather than a perfectly controlled evening.
summary.zh: 你的虚构晚餐有清楚展开形状。备好的部分开始，下一部分有自己的时刻，也能明白收尾。画像珍惜有用顺序，不追求完美控制夜晚。

example.en: You might put one simple shared plate on the table while the next planned part is being finished, so the guests understand where the meal is in its sequence.
example.zh: 你可能先上一份简单共同餐盘，再完成已计划的下一部分，让来客知道晚餐进到哪里。

strength.en: A modest sequence can make preparation and participation easier to follow without requiring every minute of conversation to be scheduled.
strength.zh: 适度顺序让准备与参与更易跟随，不必把每分钟聊天都排进日程。

tradeoff.en: A sequence can become inflexible if the host feels every planned moment must happen. A pleasant conversation may justify changing the order.
tradeoff.zh: 若主人觉得每个计划时刻都必须发生，顺序会变僵。愉快聊天也可以成为改顺序的理由。

experiment.en: For one small shared event, name just the beginning, main part and finish. Leave the timing between them loose enough for the people actually there.
experiment.zh: 为一次小共同活动，只定开始、主体和结束。中间时间留松一点，容纳实际在场的人。

summary.en: Your table offers a few understandable choices rather than one required way to take part. Different preferences can sit in the same meal. This ending concerns hosting style, not a claim that a set of options can meet every person’s needs.
summary.zh: 你的餐桌提供几种易懂选择，不要求唯一参与方式。不同偏好可以坐在同一餐里。结局只谈请客方式，不宣称一组选项能满足每个人全部需求。

example.en: For a fictional build-your-own supper, you might explain the available parts clearly and let each guest choose a combination instead of assigning everyone the same plate.
example.zh: 虚构自选晚餐里，你可能说清现有部分，让各人搭配，不给所有人分同一盘。

strength.en: A small choice can give guests agency while keeping the gathering shared, especially when everyone understands what the available options are.
strength.zh: 小选择能给来客自主，也让聚会继续共同，尤其当大家明白现有选项时。

tradeoff.en: Too many options can multiply preparation and make choosing tiring. A few distinct choices may be more usable than an elaborate range.
tradeoff.zh: 选项过多会放大准备，也让选择累。几种分明选项，可能比庞大范围更好用。

experiment.en: Offer two clear options in one small shared activity and leave the recipient free to choose. Notice whether the options help or simply add complexity.
experiment.zh: 在一个小共同活动里提供两个清楚选项，让接收者自由选择。看看它们有帮助，还是只增加复杂。

title.zh: 也能坐下来享受的主人

summary.en: Your hosting plan leaves room for the person who made the invitation to enjoy it too. Removing an extra dish can be a positive design choice. The portrait does not equate a simple meal with low effort or limited care.
summary.zh: 你的请客计划也给发出邀请的人留下享受空间。去掉额外一道，可以是积极设计选择。画像不会把简单一餐等同敷衍或少关心。

example.en: You might choose one manageable main arrangement and a simple finish so you can spend the evening at the table rather than repeatedly leaving to prepare more.
example.zh: 你可能选一个好掌握的主体安排与简单收尾，让自己留在桌边，而非反复起身继续准备。

strength.en: A manageable scale can protect the purpose of the gathering and make it easier to offer another invitation in the future.
strength.zh: 容易掌握的规模，能照顾聚会原本目的，也让以后再发邀请容易一点。

tradeoff.en: Simplifying without checking can remove something guests were relying on. A short conversation helps distinguish an optional flourish from a useful part of the plan.
tradeoff.zh: 不先询问就简化，也可能删掉来客正需要的东西。短商量能分清额外花样与有用安排。

experiment.en: Before a small invitation, remove one optional flourish and keep one thing you genuinely want to share. Check that the remaining plan is clear to everyone involved.
experiment.zh: 一次小邀请前，去掉一项可选花样，保留一件确实想分享的东西。让相关的人都明白剩下安排。
